correctness.rationale: Reconstructed B_{j+1}=B_j concatenated with its suffix after the first j symbols, with exact length ell_j=2^(j-1)+j+1. Occurrence counts satisfy T_{j+1}=2T_j-A_j+J_j, 0<=A_j<=j, 0<=J_j<=d-1, giving a cylinder-frequency limit along stages; the prefix decomposition and limsup rho<=rho/2 extend convergence to every prefix length. Each B_n embeds as an increasing subsequence into B_k repeated 2^(n-k) times, with exactly 2^(n-k)(k+1)-(n+1) deletions and limiting deletion density q_k=(k+1)/2^(k-1). A length-t block is determined by its periodic phase, internal deletion number and deletion mask. The entropy chain rule, maximum entropy G(m) of a nonnegative-integer variable of mean m, and concave binomial-mask bound F_t(m) give H_mu(t)<=log2(ell_k)+G((t-1)q_k)+F_t((t-1)q_k). Choosing k=ceil(L+2log2(L+2)+3), L=log2(t+2), yields H_mu(t)<=L+2log2(L+2)+7 for all t>=2. Hence h_mu=0; Shallit establishes that the factor language is the golden-mean language and its topological entropy is positive. Finite embedding/entropy checks corroborate only finite instances, not the universal proof.
